tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a public product to the current visitor cart. Products requiring option selection must be opened on the product page.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

sku.description: Product SKU to add when product ID is not provided.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Check public product availability. Returns availability state only, not raw stock counts.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Get public storefront categories with localized names and URLs.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get public details for one product or up to 20 product IDs.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

tools.name: get_shipping_estimate
tools.description: Estimate available shipping methods for the current cart and destination.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

country_id.description: Zen Cart country ID. Defaults to store country.

country_iso2.description: Two-letter country code, such as NZ, JP, US.

zone_id.description: Zen Cart zone ID when known.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Get public OK Gift Shop store information and supported read-only tools.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search public products using the storefront search logic. Returns at most 20 public products.

language.description: Response language: en, jp, or zh. Defaults to the current page language.

query.description: Search keyword, SKU, manufacturer, or synonym.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

madein_nz.description: Set to 1 to return only Made in New Zealand products.

new_item.description: Set to 1 to return only products marked as New Item.

categories_id.description: Optional comma-separated category IDs to include.

exclude_categories.description: Optional comma-separated category IDs to exclude.
